messages:
sam: Heads-up: CI started failing on macOS arm runners when doing `pip install -e .` for the python SDK. Error points to `typing_extensions` and the async client import. Repro steps + logs below.

sam: ```
$ pip install -e .
Obtaining file:///workspace/redwood-python-sdk
Installing collected packages: typing-extensions, ...
ERROR: Cannot import name 'TypeAlias' from 'typing_extensions' (/opt/homebrew/Library/.../typing_extensions/__init__.py)
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File ".../redwood/client/async_client.py", line 12, in <module>
    from typing_extensions import TypeAlias
ImportError: cannot import name 'TypeAlias' from 'typing_extensions'
```

sam: Using Python 3.10.6, pip 23.2, poetry 1.6.1. Strange thing: the same job on x86 runners passes.

anna: Can you paste `pip freeze` from the failing runner and a minimal snippet of `poetry.lock` so we can spot a transitive dep?

sam: pip freeze: `typing-extensions==4.0.1
packaging==23.1`

sam: poetry.lock snippet: ```
[[package]]
name = "some-dep"
version = "1.2.3"
dependencies = {"typing-extensions" = "^4.0"}
```

leo: This smells like an editable install + lockfile mismatch on mac arm pulling an older typing-extensions into the virtualenv. Two quick options: pin `typing-extensions` explicitly in `pyproject.toml` or bump the minimum to a version that exports `TypeAlias`.

leo: Example patch to `pyproject.toml` suggestion: ```
[tool.poetry.dependencies]
python = "^3.9 || ^3.10 || ^3.11"
typing-extensions = ">=4.6.0,<5"  # ensures TypeAlias and other backports
```

maria: We should also add a CI job that runs `pip install -e .` on macos-latest with `runs-on: macos-13` to catch editable/install-time issues. I'll draft the GH Actions snippet: ```
jobs:
  editable-install-macos:
    runs-on: macos-13
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'
      - run: python -m pip install --upgrade pip
      - run: pip install -e .
      - run: python -c "import redwood
from redwood.client import async_client"
```

devx-bot: CI update: build-wheel-macos-arm64 failed on job `unit-matrix` — see https://ci.redwood.example/12345 (logs attached).

sam: Thanks — I'll open a PR with the `typing-extensions` pin + the GH Actions job and add a note in CONTRIBUTING about editable installs / PEP 660. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-python-sdk/pull/1234 (will add tests).

anna: Nice. For the release checklist please add a small test that spawns a clean venv and does `import redwood.client.async_client` so we don't regress.

sam: Will do. Also adding a short blurb in the release notes about the typing-extensions compatibility on mac arm. :thumbsup:

anna: Thanks — ping me when PR is ready and I'll review quickly. :+1:
